## Token.fromUsd() method

Quotes an amount in USD (scaled by WAD) in this token. Returns `undefined` iff the token's price is undefined.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fromUsd(amount: bigint, rounding?: RoundingDirection): bigint | undefined;
```
